meta.description: Parameterisation fixtures: parameter(gamma) -> (lambda, theta, phi); rotation(gamma) -> (d-1)x(d-1); ONB(mu) -> d x d (last column = mu/|mu|); covariance_matrix_gamma(mu, gamma, p) for p = 1, -1, 0.5
